emails.subject_line_a: Quick build for Academy Roofing Inc.
emails.body_text:
Hey Curt,

I was looking at academyroofinginc.com — huge respect for 45+ years of trusted Front Range roofing since founding Academy Roofing in 1980.

One mobile conversion leak caught my eye: mobile homeowners on academyroofinginc.com still hit a static 8-field form with zero instant Front Range ballpark pricing for Class-4 hail shingles or metal.

So I built a working 30-second Denver Roof Estimator in your burgundy-and-slate Academy Roofing Inc. branding. Homeowners tap their roof size, slope, and material tier to see an honest local ballpark before leaving their name and phone.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

objection_handlers.objection: Every Denver roof has different decking, flashing, and code needs — I don't want online quotes boxing us in.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: 100% agree — this never issues a binding bid. It gives an honest Denver & Front Range ballpark range with a clear on-site inspection disclaimer so low-ball shoppers filter themselves out while qualified homeowners book already expecting real licensed pricing ($14,400–$19,200+).

objection_handlers.objection: We already get strong word-of-mouth referrals and repeat business.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: That local reputation is gold — and even referred neighbors still pull up academyroofinginc.com on their phone at 8pm before calling. A 30-second estimator simply captures the ready-to-buy homeowners already visiting your site who want a ballpark before dialing.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $750 setup + $149/mo when we already have a website contact form?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Blind static forms leak mobile shoppers who bounce before typing 7+ fields. This drops directly onto your homepage, tags urgent Denver storm and leak leads into your priority slot, updates regional pricing quarterly, and a single extra closed roof ($17,000+) pays for 3+ years.

objection_handlers.objection: I don't want anyone breaking or redesigning academyroofinginc.com.
